# Separator

**Name:** `core/separator`
**Category:** [design](/docs/reference-guides/core-blocks/category-design.md)
**API Version:** [3](/docs/reference-guides/block-api/block-api-versions/)
**Block Type:** [Static](/docs/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering.md) (saved in post content)

**Keywords:** `horizontal-line`, `hr`, `divider`
